snippet.title: Saloon Sally for the BBC Micro
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

???


Game description:

Saloon Sally is an interesting twist on the Pengo formular. 

Bandits are in the saloon, drinking and gambling. They have hidden their gold here and your task as Sally is to get it before they do. 

You have to kick the tables with the gold to get it.
